description: This file contains Flutter widget tests for the 'Thumbnail' widget, specifically golden tests that verify consistent rendering across different device pixel ratios and sizes. It sets up testing utils, defines various sizes and DPRs, and includes multiple test cases to ensure visual stability.

methods.name: expectGoldenForSizeAndDpr
methods.description: A helper function that renders the Thumbnail widget at a specific size and device pixel ratio, then compares it to a golden file to verify visual correctness.
